g.text: Accuracy, coverage, and timeliness versus speed

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526378

g.text: Three 200M-instruction cases. Each label gives the x metric and cycle reduction. The y scale varies by workload.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172437
font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378

g.text: Useful accuracy = (timely + late first uses) / accepted requests. Timely coverage = matched timely first uses / original NoPF LLC misses.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378

g.text: Timeliness = timely / (timely + late first uses). NoPF and this temporal control accepted zero requests and have undefined accuracy and timeliness.
